question.problem: What is the trace in the $xz$-plane of the hyperboloid of one sheet $\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{8}=1?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $xz$-plane, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the hyperboloid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{{0}^{2}}{5}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{8}=1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{3}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{8}=1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of the ellipse in $xy$-plane.
